WITH award_hand_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.bats, '') as bats,
    COUNT(*) as award_count
  FROM player_award pa
  INNER JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '')
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(award_count) as total_awards,
    COUNT(*) as num_hands
  FROM award_hand_counts
)
SELECT 
  ahc.bats,
  ahc.award_count,
  ahc.award_count * 1.0 / t.total_awards as share,
  ahc.award_count * 1.0 / t.total_awards - 1.0 / t.num_hands as above_average
FROM award_hand_counts ahc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE ahc.award_count * 1.0 / t.total_awards > 1.0 / t.num_hands
ORDER BY ahc.bats

assumptions.assumption: COALESCE is used to treat NULL and empty string values in the bats column as a single 'blank/missing' group, per the request's phrase 'blank or missing hand as its own group'
